reviewed_by: Claude review of harness and MCP server deletion
reason: The Trash icon buttons on the Agent harnesses and MCP servers cards in Settings called deleteHarness / deleteMcpServer on the first click with no confirmation, so one stray tap on a 14 px icon removed a saved profile and its credentials binding; the interface principles require a clear confirmation for destructive actions and a tooltip on every icon button, and the Edit and Delete icons had neither. HarnessSettings now asks through the shared DialogProvider confirmation (danger tone, 'Delete harness' / 'Delete MCP server' confirm labels) before deleting, keeps the same busy, reload and error handling, and gives the four icon buttons title tooltips. HarnessSettings.test.tsx gains a case that clicking Delete opens the confirmation, Cancel leaves the profile untouched and never calls the API, and confirming calls deleteHarness with the profile id and revision then reloads; the existing 13 cases in the file cover the surrounding save, check, import and edit flows and pass unchanged.
exclusions: No Python tests: no backend change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:mcp-import (matched through HarnessSettings*) is the real-Core 'mcp import previews, saves, trusts, probes' journey across eight desktop and phone projects and never deletes a harness or server; the confirmation surface is the same DialogProvider dialog other journeys already drive. No screenshot baselines: no layout change beyond a native title tooltip. This session did not exercise the delete flow in a real browser; the unit test drives the confirmation and API call through the rendered component. No full suites.
